Candies

I’m not the type to like sweets. But I’m also not blind to the delicious classic
candies the Filipino market has to offer. If I want you to try our culture and
my childhood as much as I can — there are a few classics I want you to try. I
got these more often when it’s the brief Halloween in Oktubre, or when
they’re prizes or giveaways in Filipino parties.
